## CoverSleep v1.3.0

### What's new

* **Cleaner messages on newer Kindles:** on firmware 5.16.3 and later, the message you see when you tap **Custom Screensaver** now appears in a bordered box in the middle of the screen, in the Kindle's own font (Amazon Ember), and goes away by itself after a few seconds. Older firmware keeps the one-line message at the bottom.

### Which ZIP do I need?

| Package | For |
| --- | --- |
| `coversleep-1.3.0-kindlepw2.zip` | Older firmware, e.g. Paperwhite 2 on 5.12.x (tested on 5.12.2.2) |
| `coversleep-1.3.0-kindlehf.zip` | Firmware 5.16.3 and later (tested on Kindle 11th gen, 5.18.1) |

### Upgrading from v1.2.x

Turn CoverSleep off from the Library, then copy the new `documents` and `extensions` contents over the old ones and turn it back on. Your images in `/screensavers/` are kept.

New installs: see the README for full instructions.
